SELECT a.COURSE_ID, COURSE_NAME, LECTURER, COIN, HOURS, CASE WHEN COURSE_TYPE = 1 THEN '线上授课' ELSE '线下授课' END COURSE_TYPE, CASE WHEN TEACH_METHOD = 1 THEN '常规课程' ELSE '任务课程' END TEACH_METHOD, TEACH_OBJECT, STUDY_TYPE, BEG_DATE, END_DATE, CASE WHEN IF_EXAM = 1 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END IF_EXAM, CASE WHEN IF_EVAL = 1 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END IF_EVAL, CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN '已发布' ELSE '未发布' END STATUS, EVAL_DATE, COURSE_SCORE, HANDLE_PLO, HANDLE_DATE, STUDY_NUM, CASE
WHEN TOP_FLAG = 1 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END TOP_FLAG, EVAL_SCORE, RECOMMEND, nvl( b.DURATION, 0 ) DURATION FROM TRM_COURSE_LIBS a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COURSE_ID, sum( DURATION ) AS DURATION FROM TRM_COURSE_FILE GROUP BY COURSE_ID ) b ON ( a.COURSE_ID = b.COURSE_ID)

select PLO_NUM,BEG_DATE,END_DATE,QUES_NUM,PASS_NUM,RIGHT_NUM,case when PASS_FLAG=1 then '通过' when PASS_FLAG=0 then '不通过' else '未完成' end PASS_FLAG from TRM_COURSE_EXAM WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select CONT from TRM_SATISFY_JOURNO WHERE JOURNO = #{journo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by TEMP_NO

select DEPT_NUM,DEPT_GROUP,count(a.PLO_NUM) total_num,count(b.PLO_NUM) study_num,to_char(round(count(b.PLO_NUM)/count(a.PLO_NUM),4),'FM9990.0000')*100 rate from (select DEPT_NUM,DEPT_GROUP,PLO_NUM,PLO_NAME from CUS_EMP_INFO where job_level between '100' and '110' and PLO_STATUS='00' and DEPT_GROUP is not null) a left join (select PLO_NUM from TRM_STUDY_LOG WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STUDY_COMP=1 ) b on (a.PLO_NUM = b.PLO_NUM) group by DEPT_NUM,DEPT_GROUP ORDER BY DEPT_NUM,DEPT_GROUP
